relationships.subject: SCN9A
relationships.evidence_quote: The frequency of SCN9A and SCN11A variants in patients with painful-SFN was higher than in painful-DPN and painless-DPN

relationships.subject: SCN10A
relationships.evidence_quote: while the frequency of the SCN10A variant was lower in patients with painful-DPN and painful-SFN compared to painless-DPN

key_findings: 125 potentially pathogenic sodium channel gene variants found in 17.2% of 1125 painful/painless DPN and SFN patients.
SCN9A and SCN11A variants were most frequent in painful-SFN; SCN10A variants in painless-DPN.
